senses.gloss: f. (compendiaria, sub. via) a short cut, path.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 9:5">Ber. IX, 5</cite> (<cite ref="Berakhot 54a:7">54ᵃ</cite>) <he>לא יעשנו ק׳</he> one must not use the Temple mount for a short cut. Y. ib. I, 2ᵇ bot. <he>ההוא דאזיל ליה בקפונדרא</he> one that walks (from the top of Mount Carmel to the Ocean) by the short cut, opp. <cite ref="A01511"><he>איסרטא</he></cite>. Bab. ib. 62ᵇ (phonetic etymol.) <he>דמק̇̇̇ אד̇̇ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="D01026"><he>דָּרָא</he> I</cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 29a:13">Meg. 29ᵃ</cite>. Tanḥ. K’doshim 8 <he>וקרב לפני המלך בקופנדר</he> (Ms. Michael O. <he>קומפנדר</he>) approached the king on a side road (instead of being duly announced); a. fr.
